Restaurant Cleaning Services in NYC & NJ

Home > Services > Offices & Commercial

Opura provides professional restaurant cleaning services for kitchens and dining rooms across New York City, Nassau County, and Northern New Jersey, keeping them clean, safe, and inspection-ready. 

No two restaurants run in the same way, and anyone who’s worked a Friday dinner rush knows the schedule can’t bend around a cleaning crew. So we do it the other way around, building a flexible program that fits your service hours, your menu, and whatever else your operation needs to thrive. 

Get a Quote Now
Call: +1 718 969 0845

Health-Code and Inspection-Ready Cleaning

Your reputation is only as good as your last inspection, and your customers trust you with more than a meal. Our cleaning supports food-contact safety in line with FDA Food Code principles and CDC hygiene guidance. 

Just as importantly, we keep documented checklists and deliver consistent results, which means staying ready for NYC and New Jersey health-department inspections becomes part of the routine instead of a scramble every time someone hears an inspector is in the neighborhood.

Kitchen, Hood, and Grease Cleaning

Grease is the enemy in any commercial kitchen. It builds up quietly on surfaces, equipment exteriors, and prep lines until one day it’s a fire risk, a slip hazard, and an inspection problem all at once. 

We clean the high-grease zones regularly to keep buildup down and the cooking environment safer, and we coordinate scheduled deep cleans for hoods, walls, and equipment based on your volume and what local codes require.

Front-of-House and Dining-Room Cleaning

Guests form an opinion the moment they walk in, well before the first plate lands. Dining rooms, bars, restrooms, entryways, glass. All of it shapes the experience, and we keep it spotless so the space holds up its end of the bargain alongside your food. If the floors need more than routine care, floor polishing or carpet cleaning can be folded into the same program.

Cold Storage, Prep Areas, and FIFO Support

A cluttered walk-in slows everyone down. We clean coolers, freezers, and prep areas, and we support FIFO-ready, organized storage so your team isn’t wrestling with the shelves to maintain food safety between services. It’s one of those small things that makes every shift after it run a little smoother.

Emergency and Post-Construction Turnaround

Sometimes there just isn’t time to do things gradually. A grand opening looming, construction dust coating every surface, an inspection that moved up on you. When time is the issue, our emergency cleaning support gets your restaurant ready, and fast.

Why Restaurants Choose Opura

  • Fully insured and bonded, with customizable service plans
  • Trained and background-checked cleaning teams
  • OSHA-compliant chemical handling and documented procedures
  • CDC-aligned cleaning and sanitation practices
  • Supervisor oversight with structured checklists and spot checks
  • Flexible daytime, evening, and overnight scheduling

How Our Restaurant Cleaning Service Works

Call: +1 718 969 0845
Step 1

Walkthrough and Plan

We come out, look at your space properly, and set a customized scope, frequency, and checklist built around how the building actually gets used.

Step 2

Setup and Supplies

Our team shows up with professional-grade equipment and safer product options. EPA Safer Choice products are available on request.

Step 3

Service and Quality Checks

Cleaners work from detailed checklists, supervisors spot-check what’s been done, and the plan gets updated whenever it needs to be.

Standards We Follow

We follow CDC hygiene guidance on when to clean, sanitize, or disinfect, FDA Food Code principles for food-contact safety where they apply, and OSHA Hazard Communication rules for labels, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and worker training. EPA Safer Choice products are available on request.

Coverage Across the Tri-State Area

We provide restaurant cleaning across New York City, Nassau County, and Northern New Jersey, including NYC restaurant cleaning for the kind of busy kitchens and dining rooms where genuine downtime barely exists. 

Opura proudly serves clients across New York City, Nassau County, and Northern New Jersey from our office at Suite 1A, 11 Park Place, New York, NY 10007. Contracts stay flexible too, so businesses and property managers can settle on whatever schedule and scope suits the way the restaurant is run.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is included in restaurant cleaning services?

Kitchen surfaces and prep areas, high-grease zones, cold storage, dining rooms, bars, restrooms, glass, and floors. The exact scope gets tailored to your venue, with scheduled deep cleans worked in around your volume and local code.

How often should a restaurant kitchen be deep cleaned?

The usual pattern is daily light cleaning plus scheduled deep cleans for hoods, walls, and equipment. How often depends on your volume and what the local code requires; rather than guessing, we sit down and set a plan with you.

Can you help us prepare for a health inspection?

Yes. We prep checklists and walk the space with you so your kitchen and dining areas stay inspection-ready, in line with Food Code and CDC guidance.

Do you offer emergency or post-construction restaurant cleaning?

Yes. Grand openings, post-construction cleanups, and urgent situations of most kinds. We handle fast turnarounds regularly.

Do you bring supplies and use safer products?

Yes. Professional equipment and supplies come with us to every job, and EPA Safer Choice products are available on request.
